page_title: CAD 0-0 RSO | Cadiz CF v Real Sociedad 21/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows the whistle, Rominigue Kouame (Cadiz) is penalised for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Real Sociedad.
90+6' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
90+4' Fali just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) replaces him.
90+3' Fali (Cadiz) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

90' Rominigue Kouame (Cadiz) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Cadiz CF.
88' The Real Sociedad players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
85' Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
85' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Javier Iglesias Villanueva had an easy-decision to make.
84' Real Sociedad fail to score from a corner as David Gil (Cadiz) leaps to collect the ball.
83' The free kick from long range, taken by Real Sociedad, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
82' Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) makes a rough challenge and Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle for a foul. Real Sociedad will take a free kick near the side line.
80' Aritz Elustondo is being substituted because of an injury. Imanol Alguacil sends Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) on the pitch.
79' The corner is swung in but Cadiz CF can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
79' Cadiz CF can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Cadiz CF win a corner.

78' Alex Remiro pulls off a fantastic save! Chris Ramos (Cadiz) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Cadiz CF.
77' Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ivan Alejo.
76' Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
75' Real Sociedad are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
73' Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
69' Imanol Alguacil is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) suffers an injury and Aritz Elustondo comes on.
69' Imanol Alguacil prepares a substitution. Umar Sadiq is replaced by Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad).
69' Substitution. Mikel Merino walks off the pitch and Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.

68' Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) beats several players before unleashing a long-range shot on goal that flies miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
65' The manager makes a subsitution with Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) coming on for Maximiliano Gomez.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Rominigue Kouame (Cadiz) will replace Robert Navarro.
64' Sergio decides to make a substitution. Alex Fernandez will be replaced by Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz).

64' A precise low pass is received by Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
63' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
63' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
61' The corner from Lucas Pires (Cadiz) is intercepted by the defence.
59' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) controls a cross deep inside the box and hits the crossbar!
58' The attendance is 17693.
56' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot! The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
55' Fali (Cadiz) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
53' The resulting set piece from Cadiz CF is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
51' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alex Remiro intercepts the ball.
48' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

48' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

47' What a miss! Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
46' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

46' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Real Sociedad will take a corner.
46' We are about to witness a subsitution. Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) for Alvaro Odriozola.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is able to continue to play.
45+1' Real Sociedad couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as David Gil (Cadiz) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
44' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) commits a rough challenge and Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle for a foul. Real Sociedad earn a free kick.
42' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
39' Kieran Tierney (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but David Gil comes off his line to gather the ball.
36' Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle and signals a foul after Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) brought his opponent down. There is a free kick near the sideline to Cadiz CF.
34' The foul by Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) was seen by Javier Iglesias Villanueva who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
32' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
30' Real Sociedad couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as David Gil (Cadiz) leaped high and intercepted the cross.

29' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Javier Iglesias Villanueva stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Free kick. Real Sociedad will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
28' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the bottom left corner is denied by a decent save from David Gil.
22' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) drives a shot towards the bottom right corner from inside the box, but Alex Remiro leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.
19' Fali (Cadiz) jumps for a header from the resulting set piece, but it goes way wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
19' Corner kick. Cadiz CF will have an opportunity.
18' A cross into the box from Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) is cleared. Cadiz CF force a corner. They send men into the box.
17' The game is interrupted as Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) is flagged offside.
15' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to David Gil, who smothers the ball.
15' Real Sociedad quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
15' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.

11' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
10' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
10' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cadiz CF.
10' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
9' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
9' The ball is cleared after Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Cadiz CF force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

8' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
5' Cadiz CF hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
2' Surely that's handball by one of the Real Sociedad players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cadiz CF, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

1' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) brings his opponent down. Javier Iglesias Villanueva has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Cadiz CF, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
1' The match has just started.
Cadiz CF will kick the game off.
Javier Iglesias Villanueva will supervise the game today.
